name: Multiple NFT projects
rootCause: According to the official news of each project, the Discord of NFT projects whose servers are currently under attack include BAYC, Doodles, Nyoki, Shamanz, Zooverse, Dreadfuls, Freaky Labs, and Kaijukingz. In addition, the source code of the verification robot Captcha has been leaked, and the private message tool Ticket tool has been attacked.
